findings.current: Five years ago, you drugged someone at a club called Burning Moon or something and got caught trying to sexually assault her.
findings.defect: The draft changes a sexual assault being committed into merely an attempted assault and adds a specifically female victim absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 저지르다가 걸렸던 states that he was caught while committing the sexual assault, not before completing it; the victim's gender is unstated.
findings.replacement: Five years ago, you got caught sexually assaulting someone after drugging them at some club called Burning Moon.
findings.source: 5년 전에 버닝문인가 뭔가 하는 클럽에서 약 타서 성폭행 저지르다가 걸렸던 거.

findings.current: With his frequent media exposure, he was one of the most prominent S-rank Hunters in the world. There was no way I wouldn’t know him.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the specific claim that he ranks first or second among S-rank Hunters in frequency of media exposure with the broader and unsupported claim that he is globally prominent.
findings.rationale: 1, 2위를 다투는 explicitly supplies the first-or-second quantity, and 잦은 미디어 노출 is the criterion being ranked.
findings.replacement: He ranked first or second even among S-rank Hunters when it came to media exposure, so there was no way I wouldn’t know him.
findings.source: 잦은 미디어 노출로는 S급 헌터 중에서도 1, 2위를 다투는 놈이니 모를 수가 없다.

findings.current: “You’re an A-rank Hunter, but you’re getting carried away because the Chairman expects something from you and thinks highly of you—!”
findings.defect: The draft omits the politically marked address “Comrade Chairman,” adds the unsupported claim that the Chairman thinks highly of Taekyung, and weakens the accusation that Taekyung has forgotten his place.
findings.rationale: 주석 동지 is “Comrade Chairman,” while 하늘 높은 줄 모르고 나대 describes presumptuous behavior without knowing one’s place; it does not separately state that the Chairman thinks highly of him.
findings.replacement: “You’re just an A-rank Hunter, but because Comrade Chairman expects great things from you, you’ve forgotten your place and started running wild—!”
findings.source: 「A급 헌터 주제에 주석 동지의 기대를 받는다고 하늘 높은 줄 모르고 나대……!」

findings.current: No matter how reckless I might seem, I still observed the bare minimum of propriety.
findings.defect: The draft turns Taekyung’s calculation of circumstances or consequences into observance of etiquette, obscuring why he waits for Wu Heixing to provide justification by drawing his weapon.
findings.rationale: 경우를 따지다 means to consider the circumstances or consequences, not to observe propriety; the following lines explain that Taekyung is calculating whether he has grounds to attack.
findings.replacement: No matter how reckless I might seem, I still weighed the circumstances at least a little.
findings.source: 내가 아무리 막 나가는 것 같아도 최소한의 경우는 따진다.

findings.current: There were even occasional rumors that she had washed her identity clean and was living a new life somewhere beneath the surface.
findings.defect: “Somewhere beneath the surface” incorrectly reads the idiom as the physical location of her new life, and “washed her identity clean” is unnatural English.
findings.rationale: 수면 아래에서는 refers to information circulating out of public view, while 신분을 세탁하다 means to erase or replace one’s prior identity.
findings.replacement: Behind the scenes, it wasn’t uncommon to hear that she had assumed a new identity and begun a new life.
findings.source: 수면 아래에서는 신분을 세탁한 뒤 새로운 삶을 살고 있다는 소식도 심심찮게 들려올 정도였다.

findings.current: “I’m asking you both to stop now.”
findings.defect: The draft makes Pai Chen demand a complete and immediate stop, losing the measured request that both men moderate their behavior.
findings.rationale: 부탁이니 and 해 줬으면 좋겠는데 make the line a restrained request, while 적당히 means to keep the behavior within reasonable bounds rather than necessarily stop altogether.
findings.replacement: “I’d appreciate it if you both toned it down.”
findings.source: 「부탁이니 적당히 해 줬으면 좋겠는데. 두 사람 모두.」

summary: One critical action reversal and five additional fidelity or register issues.
